_note: Who each kit file belongs to. An event's creative may use brand, person, photo and its own venue/event files only; never another event's venue photos, clips or RSVP QR code (engine/tools/check-event.mjs enforces this). New venue files are named <event-slug>-<what>.<ext>. "text": true marks a file that carries its own words or numbers (QR codes, screenshots, maps); the change pipeline holds any request that newly adds one, because its rendered-text checks cannot read text inside an image.
